name: Drowned Reef
summary: The Drowned Reef is a treacherous stretch of coastal waters off the southern cliffs of the Arathi Highlands. Beneath the waves lie ancient sunken ruins, claimed by hostile Daggerspine naga who appear able to control the bay's tides, endangering passing vessels.

sections.title: A Graveyard of Ships
sections.body: Just outside the hidden entrance to Faldir's Cove, the Drowned Reef forms a watery graveyard for navigators. Shattered ships, including the Maiden's Folly and the Spirit of Silverpine, lie submerged beneath the waves. Daggerspine naga led by Prince Nazjak inhabit the reef and appear able to control the bay's tides, dooming crews seeking refuge in the cove.

sections.title: The Sunken City
sections.body: Those brave or foolish enough to dive into the deep water will discover the submerged architecture of an ancient elven city. Calcified elven gems remain among its drowned ruins.

faq.answer: The Drowned Reef is a hazardous marine zone along the southern coast of the Arathi Highlands, situated just offshore from Faldir's Cove. It is known for its shallow, ship-breaking shoals and ancient ruins lurking beneath the sea.

faq.q: Why are there so many sunken ships here?
faq.answer: The reef is dangerous to ships navigating the southern Arathi coast. Its Daggerspine naga appear able to control the bay's tides, endangering crews trying to find refuge in Faldir's Cove.

The reef is inhabited by the Daggerspine tribe of naga, who dwell within the flooded ruins. Their local forces are directed by Prince Nazjak, who commands them to prey upon stranded sailors and protect their submerged territory.

faq.q: What are the ruins submerged beneath the reef?
faq.answer: The reef contains the ruins of an ancient elven city, with calcified elven gems among its submerged remains.

angles.text: The flooded halls beneath the reef and the calcified gems resting in the seabed are somber reminders of the Kaldorei empire that shattered into the sea ten thousand years ago during the Great Sundering.
